rules.title: Rent control base rent and increase restrictions
rules.quote: All rents for rental of housing space and services in dwellings to which this act is applicable are hereby controlled at the base rent level received by the landlord as of October 1, 1985, and no rental increases shall be hereinafter demanded, paid or accepted, except as provided in this chapter.
rules.summary: Rents are controlled at the base rent level as of October 1, 1985, and increases are only allowed as provided in the chapter.
rules.coverage_text: All rents for rental of housing space and services in dwellings to which this act is applicable
rules.exemption_note: Exemptions for newly constructed dwellings and buildings completely vacant since January 1, 1984 are referenced in § 155-16
rules.penalty: Any rent increases imposed after October 1, 1985, to the extent that such increases are in excess of the rent increases allowed under this ordinance, are hereby declared to be null and void

rules.title: Annual rent increase limit at lease expiration or termination
rules.quote: At the expiration of a lease or at the termination of a lease of a periodic tenant, no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index three months prior to the expiration or termination of the lease and three months prior to the commencement of the lease term, whichever is less.
rules.summary: At lease expiration or termination, rent increases are capped at 5% or the CPI percentage difference for the lease period, whichever is less.

rules.title: Tax surcharge for property taxes
rules.quote: For any application for a tax surcharge after the effective date of this chapter, a landlord may seek a tax surcharge to be charged to a tenant because of an increase in municipal property taxes if said taxes are in excess of those assessed for the year that the landlord acquired the property or for the 1988 tax year, whichever assessment date is later.
rules.summary: Landlords may seek a tax surcharge from tenants for municipal property tax increases above the 1988 tax year or the year the landlord acquired the property, whichever is later.
rules.exemption_note: Rental units must be registered to qualify for a tax surcharge

rules.title: Water and sewerage surcharge
rules.quote: The landlord may seek a water and sewerage surcharge from a tenant because of an increase in the municipal water and sewer charges in excess of those assessed for 1996.
rules.summary: Landlords may seek a water and sewer surcharge from tenants for increases in municipal water and sewer charges above those assessed for 1996.

rules.title: Capital improvement surcharge
rules.quote: Upon notice to its tenants, a landlord may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a rental surcharge for capital improvement to the building and/or demised premises.
rules.summary: Landlords may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a rental surcharge for capital improvements to the building or individual units.
rules.exemption_note: The dwelling must be in compliance with housing maintenance, building, fire and other applicable City codes, and not subject to a City-held title lien

rules.title: Capital improvement surcharge limitation
rules.quote: In making this determination, the Board shall consider the nature and the cost of the improvement and the effect that the proration of the surcharge shall have on the existing base rents, it being the intent of this chapter that the base rents shall under no circumstances be increased by an amount greater than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any one twelve-month period.
rules.summary: Base rents cannot be increased by more than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any twelve-month period.

rules.title: Hardship rental increase
rules.quote: In the event that a landlord cannot meet his operating expenses or does not make a fair return on his investment, he may appeal to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a hardship rental increase.
rules.summary: Landlords who cannot meet operating expenses or achieve a fair return on investment may appeal to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a hardship rental increase.

rules.title: Tenant application for rent decrease
rules.quote: When services, care or maintenance decline in any dwelling, any tenant may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a decrease in rent.
rules.summary: Tenants may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a rent decrease when services, care, or maintenance decline.
